title: Canonical data and authority requirements

requirements: preserve chainId
preserve canonical block hash
trace transaction, receipt and logs to the same block provenance
never infer success from transaction hash alone
authorities.conflict_resolution: canonical chain state wins; Explorer/Indexer projection is stale, degraded or incorrect until reconciled

requirements: head, safe and finalized remain distinct
finalizedHeight <= safeHeight <= indexed/head height
finalized history is not rewritten by ordinary Explorer/Indexer repair
authorities.conflict_resolution: fail closed on inconsistent finality ordering; do not collapse statuses

authorities.indexer_role: project deployed code/events without reassigning addresses
requirements: config/system-addresses.json and contracts/config/system-addresses.json remain identical
Explorer owns no reserved address
fixed predeploys are not replaced by candidate or Registry-resolved application addresses
authorities.conflict_resolution: frozen address map wins for fixed predeploy identity

authorities.indexer_role: project Registry service/version history with provenance
requirements: preserve service ID, version, active state and implementation provenance
do not treat unpublished candidate address as active
security-sensitive clients may recheck direct canonical Registry state
authorities.conflict_resolution: canonical ProtocolRegistry state wins over Explorer/Indexer cache or documentation

authorities.canonical_authority: canonical chain plus owning protocol state
requirements: databaseIsNonCanonical remains true
Explorer implements no independent checkpoint store
Explorer implements no independent ingestion or reorg engine
derived projections may be discarded/rebuilt
authorities.conflict_resolution: rebuild/reconcile projection from canonical sources; never promote database contents to authority

authorities.canonical_authority: deployed runtime bytecode plus canonical deployment provenance; Registry commitments for registered version metadata
requirements: verified-source metadata cannot override runtime bytecode
labels cannot change execution truth
decoder output retains original chain/log provenance and Registry version provenance
authorities.conflict_resolution: runtime bytecode and canonical chain provenance win over labels, source claims or decoded metadata

authorities.canonical_authority: underlying address plus owning Names/Identity protocol state
requirements: labels never replace the underlying address
absence of label does not make address invalid
label disagreement cannot change transaction/contract provenance
authorities.conflict_resolution: display raw address and canonical owning-protocol facts; treat enrichment as secondary

authorities.canonical_authority: canonical transaction/receipt plus owning payment/escrow/application protocol
authorities.indexer_role: project transaction, receipt and asset events
requirements: Explorer may show success/revert, participants, value and assets
Explorer must not infer invoice, escrow or application settlement semantics from a generic transfer alone
authorities.conflict_resolution: owning protocol/application settlement rules win; Explorer remains evidentiary presentation only

authorities.canonical_authority: consensus plus Stake420/validator protocol state as applicable
requirements: Explorer gains no validator or staking mutation authority
consensus status is not automatically staking/reward history
missing staking/reward view remains a workflow gap rather than inferred data
authorities.conflict_resolution: consensus and Stake420/validator protocol state win

authorities.explorer_role: no mutation authority; governance display scope remains unresolved under EXP-0
requirements: Explorer operators gain no governance authority
EXP-0.2.1 governance scope conflict remains explicit until resolved
no governance result may be synthesized from Explorer-local state

authorities.canonical_authority: user-controlled wallet/Smart Account and owning protocol contracts
requirements: Explorer cannot sign
Explorer cannot hold custody
Explorer cannot grant permissions
Explorer failure cannot block direct wallet/RPC/protocol interaction
authorities.conflict_resolution: wallet/account/protocol authority is independent of Explorer availability

authorities.canonical_authority: owning private/off-chain system and explicit on-chain commitments only where applicable
authorities.indexer_role: must not promote private payloads to canonical state
requirements: a hash or commitment visible on-chain does not make the underlying private payload public/canonical
Explorer must not imply possession or verification of hidden payloads
authorities.conflict_resolution: only the explicit public chain commitment is in Explorer scope

authorities.canonical_authority: target network identity plus authoritative upstream chain/protocol sources
authorities.indexer_role: expose chain ID, indexed/safe/finalized heights, ingest time and health state
requirements: required chain ID is 420
wrong chain must not be presented as ready
stale/degraded/inconsistent Indexer must not be presented as healthy canonical truth
clients can see indexed/finalized heights
authorities.conflict_resolution: return degraded/not-ready state rather than silently serving contradictory data as qualified

global_invariants: Explorer is never canonical protocol authority.
Indexer is never canonical protocol authority.
Derived data conflicts resolve toward canonical chain/consensus or the owning protocol contract.
Fixed Genesis predeploy identity comes from the frozen system-address map.
Registry-resolved application identity comes from canonical ProtocolRegistry state, not candidate documentation.
Presentation metadata, labels, source verification and decoded fields cannot override runtime execution truth.
Explorer must remain independently replaceable and unavailable without blocking canonical protocol interaction.
